title: Cook membrane: linear B-bar convergence and standard-brick setup
source: OpenGeoSys, Cook's membrane B-bar benchmark (Wang, page revised 2024-06-11), https://www.opengeosys.org/stable/docs/benchmarks/small-deformations/cooksmembranebbar/; the public code values and comparison tolerance are transcribed from that page.

quantities.quantity: linear B-bar top-corner vertical displacement, 4 elements per side
quantities.reason: The public B-bar benchmark asserts an absolute 2e-4 m comparison tolerance; the three meshes show the expected convergence to the published result.

quantities.quantity: linear B-bar top-corner vertical displacement, 10 elements per side
quantities.reason: The public B-bar benchmark asserts an absolute 2e-4 m comparison tolerance; the three meshes show the expected convergence to the published result.

quantities.quantity: linear B-bar top-corner vertical displacement, 30 elements per side
quantities.reason: The public B-bar benchmark asserts an absolute 2e-4 m comparison tolerance; the three meshes show the expected convergence to the published result.

quantities.quantity: linear standard-brick top-corner vertical displacement, 4 elements per side
quantities.reason: The public page reports these same-mesh standard-brick values; 1e-4 relative is above the observed 1e-5 setup difference and below the 0.1% scale of the comparison.
